# GEO report: brightside-dental

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 73/100, Good

Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points).
How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73.

The basics are in place: robots.txt, the sitemap, server-rendered pages and navigation links all work. Four things cost points: every page names a staging site as its canonical address, the `<html>` tag has no language, one page has no description, and the structured data is broken JSON. Nothing is unknown, because this is a static Eleventy site and everything is in the code. All results are read from code.

## Live check

- **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

### 1. Point the canonical address at your real site
- **Why it matters:** A canonical tag tells search engines which address is the official one for a page. Yours name a staging host, so you are telling them the real site is a copy of a different one.
- **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8`
- **What the code says:** `<link rel="canonical" href="https://staging.brightside-dental.example{{ page.url }}">`
- **Size:** Small (change the host to `https://www.brightside-dental.example`, the origin in `geo.config.json`)
- **Score after this:** 81/100 (20.25 ÷ 25)

### 2. Add a language to the page and a description to the Team page
- **Why it matters:** `lang` tells browsers and machines what language the page is in. Without a description on /team/, that page has an empty meta description.
- **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2` and `src/team.njk:1-4`
- **What the code says:** `<html>` (no `lang`), and the Team front matter has only `title: Meet the team`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 81/100 (20.25 ÷ 25)

### 3. Fix the broken structured data on the Contact page
- **Why it matters:** The JSON has a trailing comma, so it is invalid. Machines will ignore the clinic's name and phone number that it labels.
- **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10`
- **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }`
- **Size:** Small (remove the comma)
- **Score after this:** 81/100 (20.25 ÷ 25)

Doing all three gives 97/100 (24.25 ÷ 25).

## Other problems found

- **/services/ is in the sitemap and the main nav but marked noindex:** `src/services.njk:5`: `noindex: true`. If the page is meant to be found, remove that line. If it is private, remove it from `src/sitemap.xml:4`. As it stands, the services page is hidden from search, and it is one of your main pages.

## Worth considering

- **Label the clinic fully in structured data:** `src/contact.njk:7`: `Call 0113 496 0000 or visit 12 Park Row, Leeds.` The Dentist block could also carry `address`, `url`, `openingHours`, and `sameAs` links, so the facts on the page are labelled for machines.
- **Back up or drop the claim "Trusted by thousands of local patients":** `src/index.njk:7`. Real numbers, reviews or a link to them would give readers and AI tools something to quote.
- **Say who the dentists are:** `src/team.njk:6`: `decades of experience between them`. Naming each dentist with their qualifications and years of experience would answer the question a visitor comes to this page for. Each dentist could get their own page.
- **Show the prices:** `src/services.njk:9`: `Our prices are simple and clear.` No prices appear. Add "from £X" figures, or link to a price list.
- **Give each treatment a short explanation or its own page:** `src/services.njk:8`. The four treatments are bare list items, with nothing on what is involved, how long it takes or who it suits.
- **Add opening hours and how to get there:** `src/contact.njk:7`. The page has only a phone number and street address. Add hours, parking and emergency instructions as text.
- **Add `<lastmod>` dates to the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:3-6`. The file is hand-written and has no dates. Eleventy could generate it with real dates.
- **Add social tags and a site-identity block:** `src/_includes/base.njk:3-9`. There is no `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image`, and no Organization/WebSite structured data.
- **Add a 404 page:** there is no `src/404.njk`, so wrong addresses can't return a branded real 404.
- **Link between pages:** the home page links onward only to Services. Link from Services to Contact and Team to help readers move through the site.

## Can't tell from code

- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs <access log>`, which checks real crawlers against their published addresses.
- **Live-only checks** (real status codes, redirects, headers): GEO-013, GEO-014 and GEO-011 can only be fully confirmed with a live scan. Give me your URL to run one. These checks don't change the code results above.
- `/img/reception.jpg` (`src/index.njk:8`) is not in the repo and no passthrough copy is configured, so check that it is served.

## Assumptions

- You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site. `geo.config.json` says `aiSearchCrawlers: allow`.
- I read all 8 source files, including the layout, all 5 pages (4 sampled for scoring, plus the intentionally hidden /thanks/), robots.txt, the sitemap and the one JSON-LD block.
- /thanks/ is noindex and not in the sitemap, so I treated that as deliberate and left it out of the route counts.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-015`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
